verdict.rationale: Quo documents call recording ('Recorded calls come back transcribed and summarized'). Recorded calls can be found later through retrievable call history and transcripts (MCP), a list-calls API endpoint, and per-call AI summaries. Nothing in the evidence covers consent handling, such as announcements, beep or consent prompts, or per-jurisdiction one-party/two-party rules. Retrieval of the recording audio itself is not shown either. Missing for 10: jurisdiction-aware recording consent controls, explicit retrieval/search of recording audio files, documentation of recording settings, independent corroboration.

support.subject: As a support leader, I can record calls with the consent handling my jurisdictions require and find the recordings later

citations.quote: Recorded calls come back transcribed and summarized, so no detail is missed and nobody has to take notes.
